verdict.rationale: The core verification flow (creating applicants, running workflows, retrieving SDK tokens, webhooks, reports) is fully API/SDK-driven per docs, but the Workflow Studio for building/configuring verification workflows is explicitly described as a 'no-code, drag and drop interface... without the need for developer involvement,' with no documented API/config-as-code equivalent for authoring workflows themselves. Missing for 10: an API or IaC path to create/edit workflows equivalent to Workflow Studio's UI, and independent confirmation that all Dashboard settings (e.g., accepted document types) are also API-configurable.
